item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and trace the behaviors it exercises, then flag any concrete issues.

This module provides small order helpers: calculates item totals, applies discount codes, computes an “average” price, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, so its last iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined) and throws when reading `.price`. It should use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` is misleading/incorrect if it intends the average unit-item price: it divides the total by the number of line items, ignoring quantities. For example, 10 × $2 becomes `$20 / 1 = $20`, not `$2`.
- `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN` due to division by zero (once `calcTotal` is fixed); it should define an empty-order behavior.
- Because `formatOrder` calls `calcTotal`, it currently also fails for any order.
